cohort: The study included 544 couples who conceived after infertility treatment and 940 couples who conceived naturally, all of whom gave birth to a singleton infant between November 2014 and December 2019.
finding: Maternal preconception and paternal prenatal exposure to phthalates were associated with an increased risk of low birth weight in infants, with ART-conceived fetuses showing greater sensitivity to PAE mixtures compared to naturally conceived infants.
